record.name: Resume Builder: CV Maker & AI
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
This app will help you get the interview for your dream job.

Resume Builder: CV Maker & AI is the simplest way to turn your existing resume—or a blank page—into a professional, job-ready CV in minutes. Import from PDF, photo, or paste text; let AI do the structuring; then edit and export. No more retyping everything from scratch.

QUICK 3-STEP PROCESS

1. IMPORT — Upload a PDF or image of your resume, or paste text from LinkedIn, Word, or notes.
2. AI STRUCTURES — Our AI turns your content into a clean, sectioned resume (contact, experience, education, skills, and more).
3. EDIT & EXPORT — Tweak any section, choose a template, then export a high-quality PDF or print.

AI TOOLS THAT GIVE YOU AN EDGE

• AI Resume Import — Paste text or use OCR on PDF/photo; AI structures it into a full resume in one go.
• AI Summary & Experience — Generate or polish your professional summary and work bullet points with streaming AI.
• AI Skill Recommendations — Get role-based skills to add with one tap.
• AI Interview Coach (Pro) — Practice with an AI interviewer; use voice input and AI read-aloud for a hands-free mock interview.

TEMPLATES & PDF SETTINGS

• 16 professional templates — Classic, modern, and photo styles for different industries.
• Customize your PDF — Font size, font family, and page size (A4, Letter, Legal).
• Multilingual PDFs — Full support for English and Chinese (and more) in the exported file.

PRIVACY

When you import, only the extracted or pasted text is used for AI structuring—your original file is never uploaded. We do not store or share your resume text after processing.

SUBSCRIPTION (AUTO-RENEWABLE)

Unlock VIP features: unlimited AI import & generation, all premium templates, unlimited PDF export, and AI Interview Coach.

• Plans: Weekly / Monthly (prices vary by region, shown in-app before purchase).
• Payment: Charged to your Apple ID (or Google account) at confirmation of purchase.
• Renewal: Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel: In your device Account Settings (or via the in-app Restore / subscription link).

LEGAL & SUPPORT

Privacy Policy: https://resume.grozal.com/privacy-policy-en.html
Terms of Use: https://resume.grozal.com/terms-of-service-en.html
Support: Use the feedback section in the app or the contact details in our Privacy Policy.

iCloud sync to access your resume across all your devices

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Smart Resume helps you build stronger job applications from start to finish. Create a resume or CV, tailor it to a role, generate cover letters, check ATS readiness, practice interviews, and track every application in one place.

BUILD RESUMES AND CVS
Create a professional resume or CV from scratch, from your saved profile, or from an uploaded document. Use Classic Resume for a traditional free builder, or use AI tools to draft, rewrite, improve, and tailor your content faster.

TAILOR YOUR APPLICATION
Add a job description and adapt your resume for the role. Smart Resume can help improve summaries, bullet points, sections, and wording so your application is clearer, more relevant, and easier to review.

CREATE COVER LETTERS
Generate role-specific cover letters using your resume and target job details. Create polished application documents and export professional PDFs when you are ready to apply.

CHECK ATS READINESS
Run an ATS Scan to review structure, keywords, readability, and job fit. See ATS score signals, missing keywords, content gaps, and practical recommendations before you send your application.

GET AI RESUME REVIEW
Use AI Resume Review for recruiter-style feedback on clarity, positioning, impact, and weak sections. Get focused suggestions for stronger wording and better application quality.

PRACTICE INTERVIEWS
Prepare with AI interview practice based on your resume and target role. Answer mock interview questions, rehearse follow-ups, and get feedback to improve structure, confidence, and communication.

TRACK YOUR JOB SEARCH
Use the job application tracker to manage every stage, including applied, interview, offer, accepted, rejected, and follow-up. Keep application context, resume history, reminders, and outcomes organized.

SEE YOUR PIPELINE
View job search progress with Sankey Chart analytics. See how applications move from applied to interview, offer, accepted, or rejected, and identify bottlenecks in your search.

WEEKLY INSIGHTS
Get a weekly snapshot of application trends, quality scores, role-fit signals, and next steps. Premium insights can highlight blind spots, skill gaps, and high-impact resume actions based on your real results.

OPTIMIZED FOR IPAD
Smart Resume includes a dedicated iPad experience for building resumes, reviewing applications, checking ATS fit, and tracking your job search on a larger screen.

Smart Resume is built for students, graduates, first-time job seekers, career changers, active applicants, and professionals updating an old resume or CV.

No account required. No ads. No tracking. Your resume is processed to generate your roast and then forgotten — we don't operate servers that store it. Your history stays on your device, and you can clear it anytime.

record.description_evidence:
Please note that the download is free, but a subscription is required to unlock the functionality of this app. Without a subscription, you can browse the app before deciding to subscribe. After subscribing and using the app, you can still see all your information after you cancel the subscription, but you will no longer be able to add new content.

This app will help you manage your job search, with your privacy at the forefront of the design. Working across the desktop and tablet, your data is stored in your iCloud account and locally on your device (not on our servers).
In today's job market, having a resume and cover letter that are tailored specifically to each application is not only critical to pass the Applicant Tracking System automatic screening, but also key to standing out in a sea of resumes.
You begin by entering detailed overviews of your prior positions, certifications, publications, and patents. After that, you enter details and job descriptions for positions that you are interested in applying to. This app will use AI to understand the requirements for each position and write a resume that highlights the portions of your experience that best match those requirements. In addition, you can keep track of the status for each application (when did you apply, have they scheduled interviews, ...). You can also enter the key contacts and communication notes for everyone that you interact with in the application process. The app will help summarize these communications, write thank you notes after interviews, and even help with interview preparation.

While the app is free, you must purchase a subscription to make use of the application management and generative AI functions. We have built this app to use Meta's Llama3 models hosted in Amazon's AWS service, and you can subscribe to this on a monthly or annual basis. 

Privacy is very important to us, and that's why we designed the app to store all data locally on your device and in your iCloud account, so what have we done to ensure that your data is secure when using the cloud? All cloud communications are done over secure web services (https / ssl) but that's not all. Your data is encrypted by our app when being sent back and forth from the cloud, ensuring that if the secure web connection was compromised, your data is still encrypted. There is also nothing included in the data that can be tied to you (unless you have included personal information in your descriptions of your work history), with a few exceptions ... where you are the author of papers or patents, you will likely have included your name in the authors list for those works, and that data is sent to the cloud in order to write the resume; when you ask the AI to write a cover letter, your contact information is sent to the AI, however, there is an option to leave this out (please remember to edit the result to put your name and contact info in the final letter prior to using it); when you are saving communications for key contacts, you may end up using personally identifiable information in those details, and this will also be sent to the cloud. We do not save anything that is sent to or from the cloud on our servers.

This app can also use a local installation of Ollama if you want to ensure that your data never leaves your machine. In this case, the data is not encrypted when sent across your private network; this traffic is controlled by you and we have no access to it; nor can we install anything on your local machines to manage encryption on your local devices. Again, nothing is saved on our servers.

This app is offered under Apple's standard EULA: http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula
